text:
alex: Heads-up — we need to coordinate submodule merges + vendor lock bumps before Friday cutoff (release v1.14). Who owns the windows for merging submodule changes? I want to avoid an empty vendor/ diff at cutover.

priya: I can do a sweep of the go submodules today. Are we pinning grpc to 1.56.0? we had a pending PR in deps/grpc.

michael: yes pin to 1.56.0 per release notes. Also vendorize python wheel deps after lockfile bump. Will create a checklist.

essie: @alex fyi the kernel module has a local patch, need manual rebase on release branch.

alex: ok assign owners: priya for go, michael for python vendor, tess for submodule merges + conflict triage. @tess can you take the merge window 3–5pm PT today?

tess: can do. I'll open a tracking PR that merges submodules and runs `./scripts/vendor-sync.sh` and `make test`.

priya: quick Q — when you say lockfile bump, do you mean updating `go.sum` + commit vendor/ or just bump the `GOVERSION`? we should be explicit.

michael: we bump go.sum and commit vendor/, also update `third_party/requirements.txt.lock` for py. I'll add exact commands to the PR description.

deploy-bot: Reminder: release cutoff is 2026-03-20 17:00:00 UTC. Any changes merged after cutoff require release lead signoff.

alex: thanks. Also add a changelog note tag: `changelog: dependency` for these merges so release manager can include them.

essie: if anyone runs into CI failures due to submodule refs, call me — I can do hot rebase. small chance of needing a revert during canary.

tess: opening PR now: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/platform/compare/merge-submodules-1758

priya: lgtm, I'll queue the vendor bump once PR is green. ping me in thread when ready :thumbsup:

michael: FYI I'll run the `pip-compile` step locally and attach the resulting lockfile.

alex: awesome. last ask — before merging, run `scripts/check-locks.sh` and paste the output in the PR so release tools can validate.

tess: will do, thanks everyone. :rocket:
